fields.launchWriteup: I launched RepeatBio, a spaced-repetition deck for NEET biology built only from the last 11 years of actual paper questions, between 28 Aug and 8 Sep. 28 Aug: pricing live at ₹199 one time, Razorpay live mode, no subscription because droppers do not trust subscriptions. 29 and 30 Aug: I sat in the reading room of a coaching library in Ameerpet for two evenings and asked 20 droppers to use it for ten minutes on my phone - 20 tried it, 14 finished the 10-card set, 5 gave me their number, 2 paid that week. 1 Sep: posted a comparison of my deck against the free Anki deck in two Telegram NEET groups (2,100 and 640 members) - I am a member of both since my own drop year. That post got 3 payments over four days. 3 Sep: an Instagram reel showing one question being traced from the 2019 paper to the card, 9,400 views, 2 payments. 6 Sep: emailed 4 teachers I have actually studied under; 1 replied, 0 shared it. What did not work: the teacher emails, and worse, my first pricing at ₹499 - I put it live on 28 Aug, got zero payments in 36 hours from people who were clearly interested, dropped it to ₹199 on 30 Aug and had the first payment within four hours. Totals: 7 paying students, ₹1,393, which the tracker shows as $16.78 gross and $16.39 net. For the next hundred I would stop sending people to a payment page from a reel and instead send them to the 10-card free set first, because everyone who paid had finished the free set and nobody who paid came straight off a link.
fields.distributionChannels:
Coaching library, Ameerpet, 29 and 30 Aug evenings: 20 people tried it in person, 14 finished the free set, 2 paid. Cost me two evenings and ₹120 in metro fare.
Telegram NEET groups (2,100 members and 640 members), 1 post each on 1 Sep: 3 paid over the following four days. This is the cheapest channel I have and I can only use it because I was in those groups for a year before I built anything.
Instagram reel, organic, 3 Sep: 9,400 views, 211 profile visits, 2 paid. Good reach, terrible conversion.
Cold-ish email to 4 teachers I studied under, 6 Sep: 1 reply ('will see beta'), 0 shares, 0 payments. Nothing.
WhatsApp status to my own contacts: 0 payments and I am not counting it, everyone there knows me and I did not want pity purchases.
r/NEET: I drafted a post on 2 Sep and did not put it up because the subreddit rules ban promotion and I did not want to get the account banned. So: not used, nothing returned.
fields.firstCustomerStory: The first person who paid is a second-drop student I met in the Ameerpet library on 29 Aug. She was the only one in the room with the NCERT and a physical notebook of wrong answers instead of a phone, which is why I asked her first. She used the deck for eleven minutes standing at the shelf and her exact words after were 'ye 2019 wala question isme kaise aaya' - she recognised a card as a question she had got wrong in a test two days before, and that is when her face changed. She did not pay that evening. She asked whether the deck had genetics, I said only 40 cards in genetics, and she said she would wait. On 31 Aug, the day after I dropped the price to ₹199, she paid at 10:12pm - first payment on the account, ₹199, UPI. Since then she has opened the app on 9 of 11 days, finished 340 cards, and on 7 Sep she sent me a voice note complaining that the ecology cards repeat too fast. I have not fixed that yet. She also sent the link to two friends in her batch, one of whom is payment number 4. I did not ask her to do that and I only found out because the second friend told me.

notes: Dated launch actions with a real pricing experiment, six channels each carrying a number or a stated 'not used', a first customer who is traceable from the library to the payment to her later usage, a concrete learning plus a named failure, and 7 × ₹199 = ₹1,393 agrees with the tracker's $16.78 and 7 paying customers.
